MISSING_OR_AT_RISK.mechanism: RELOAD, and any per-request HOST residency belief
MISSING_OR_AT_RISK.status: CONFIRMED UNEXERCISED FOR A STRUCTURAL REASON (Session A, c707610d)
MISSING_OR_AT_RISK.evidence: cstate.py:673 _host_fraction sums est_tokens over sessions whose believed_tier() is host and divides by the host tier size, so what reaches the arm is an AGGREGATE FRACTION, not a per-request residency. A parallel real-engine probe reports host residency is observable only in aggregate on this engine. If a rung's RELOAD lever never fires, that is Rule 2 UNEXERCISED FOR A STRUCTURAL REASON and must be reported as such, not as evidence that RELOAD does not help. CONFIRMED by the H100's real-engine probe: host residency is observable only through aggregates such as vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total{source="external_kv_transfer"}; per request it is folded into prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens and cannot be separated, and differencing the aggregates is exact only with ONE request in flight. So this is evidence-backed, not a hedge.
MISSING_OR_AT_RISK.action: REPORTED, NOT ADDED. No per-request host belief is invented here.
MISSING_OR_AT_RISK.session_A_measurement: host residency IS observed, but only IN AGGREGATE: external_kv_transfer accounts for 4,943,072 of 18,707,015 prompt tokens, 26.4 percent. A PER-REQUEST host belief is NOT ACHIEVABLE on this engine, because a host hit and a GPU hit both fold into cached_tokens. So the aggregate is real and the per-request signal the RELOAD lever would need does not exist.
MISSING_OR_AT_RISK.wording_to_keep: RELOAD is UNEXERCISED FOR A STRUCTURAL REASON, not a hedge and not a null about RELOAD.

_RUNG_2_DRY_DIGEST_IS_NOT_A_PROPERTY_OF_.finding: Session A: a COMMENT-ONLY edit to engine_actions.py moves covex-v6-state-uo-c5attr's dry decision log by 85 committed-key decisions and 11 rows, purely through ALLOCATION, because arms_v6state._queued_behind keys its cache on id(obs), a memory address.
_RUNG_2_DRY_DIGEST_IS_NOT_A_PROPERTY_OF_.six_runs_settle_it: five variants plus the committed bar give 9a4be873eb3c5fba / 14,218; the one outlier 639cd15ed38c9da0 / 14,207 is the single tree with the id(obs) key LIVE and no edit to perturb allocation, matching what d190_rung4_r3_proofs.py:192-197 recorded for that arm under concurrency.
_RUNG_2_DRY_DIGEST_IS_NOT_A_PROPERTY_OF_.consequence_for_THIS_ladder: the unfixed rung-2 bar CANNOT serve as a byte-identity bar or a Step 2b baseline, and must not be quoted across trees that are not byte-identical in every module the arm imports. covex-v6-state-final turns live2_qcache_key_fix ON, which is what makes this ladder sound, and it is ALSO why covex-v6-state-final must NOT be compared against the UNFIXED rung-2 bar.
_RUNG_2_DRY_DIGEST_IS_NOT_A_PROPERTY_OF_.scope: RUNG 4 WAS NOT PERTURBED, so the sensitivity is not universal even inside the state family.
_RUNG_2_DRY_DIGEST_IS_NOT_A_PROPERTY_OF_.operational_rule: every rung-2-class dry proof cell runs ALONE. Two sessions ran dry proof cells on flash concurrently at loadavg up to 25.46, which is exactly the regime this digest class is sensitive to.
_RUNG_2_DRY_DIGEST_IS_NOT_A_PROPERTY_OF_.WHAT_THIS_DOES_TO_PROOF_c: proof (c), 'how many rung-2 decisions the id(obs) fix changes', has a NOISE FLOOR EQUAL TO THE DEFECT IT MEASURES: allocation alone moved 85 decisions and 11 rows on the unfixed arm. So a fix-ON against fix-OFF count must be read against about 85 decisions of allocation noise on the OFF side, and a count of that order is NOT separable from the noise. This is reported rather than resolved, and it is a consequence of measuring a cache-key defect with the cache key still live on one side.

THE_OFF_SWITCH_IDENTITY_BAR_NOW_PASSES_A.what_it_was_on_the_committed_family: covex-v6-cf-c5attr-off was 711 rows off its declared rung-3 bar, because _Rung4Mixin._cf_engine swapped the planner's deficit weight UNCONDITIONALLY while reading NEITHER compound switch.
THE_OFF_SWITCH_IDENTITY_BAR_NOW_PASSES_A.WHY_THE_FINAL_LADDER_CURES_IT_mechanism_: the cure is a direct consequence of the D208 design choice, not of touching the swap. In the COMMITTED family the planner limb read the live feed at RUNG 4 ONLY, so rung-4-off's unconditional swap left it holding a weight source rung 3 did not have, and the two could not agree. In the FINAL ladder D206 (2) puts the planner limb on the SAME feed AT RUNG 3 TOO (arms_final_ladder._PlannerFeedMixin is in rung 3's MRO as well as rung 4's), so an unconditional swap in rung-4-off lands on exactly the source rung 3 already uses and the collapse is exact. The Step 4 control on rung 4 therefore WORKS on this build where it did not on the committed one.

RUNG_3_DOES_NOT_RESPOND_TO_MEMORY_ON_A_D.HOW_THIS_MUST_BE_REPORTED: NOT as a memory result and NOT as an equivalence. Under Rule 2 a flat response is UNEXERCISED. A rung-3 0.25x DRY cell may not be cited as evidence about memory behaviour.
RUNG_3_DOES_NOT_RESPOND_TO_MEMORY_ON_A_D.why_it_is_the_EXPECTED_outcome_rather_th: rungs 2 and 3 make no memory trade-offs BY DESIGN; they adapt to memory pressure ONLY REACTIVELY, THROUGH ENGINE TELEMETRY, while rung 4 adapts proactively. A DRY CELL HAS NO ENGINE TELEMETRY, so on a dry cell rung 3 has nothing to react to and a flat digest is what the design predicts. A reader meeting the three identical digests should meet them as a question with its answer attached, not as agreement between conditions.
